Recent years have seen significant advancements in evaluating large language models (LLMs). These evaluations focus on assessing the model's ability to perform in-context learning and ensuring the reliability of the evaluation scores. - **Cross-validation** is a widely used method to assess the stability of LLM performance across different subsets of data. It helps ensure that the evaluation results are consistent and reliable [doc_id:2301.12004v1#s7].
